overview: Based on the published agenda, this special meeting of the Wausau School District Board of Education was scheduled to address teacher salary approvals for the 2026-27 school year and employee handbook updates. The board was expected to consider a negotiations settlement and potential changes to teaching staff compensation, along with reviewing handbook policy changes for the upcoming school year.

agenda.item: II.A. Appointments (Additional Staff, Replacement Staff, Contract Increases)

discussions.body: Elizabeth Channel and Tabatha Gundrum were scheduled to present on budget updates and potential changes to teaching staff salaries for the 2026-27 school year. The presentation was estimated to take 10 minutes and was expected to include a negotiations settlement review and the pending teacher salary schedule for board consideration.

Tabatha Gundrum was scheduled to share additional employee handbook updates for the 2026-27 school year for review and approval. The presentation was expected to take approximately 2 minutes and would include a marked-up version illustrating the suggested edits to the handbook.

publicComment: No public comment period was included on this agenda.
actionItems: Board was expected to approve the consent agenda including appointments, separations, leaves of absence, and retirements
Board was expected to consider approval of the 2026-27 teacher salary schedule and negotiations settlement
Board was expected to approve employee handbook updates for the 2026-27 school year
title: Special Meeting - 2026-08-03
